name: multi-selector

frames.best_why: Frame 2 shows the full open list with checkboxes, disabled Nuxt and Clear/Close; later frames are filtered or closed.

tagline: Pick several options from a searchable checklist that collects chips.
summary: A dropdown for choosing more than one option at once. Selected items collect as removable chips in the closed field, and the open panel adds search, select-all and a Clear action.
appearance: A dark rounded field with a thin grey outline holding small rounded chips, then a clear X and a chevron. Opened, it drops a narrow dark panel with a search row, a checkbox list and Clear and Close at the foot.
behaviour: Clicking the field opens a searchable checklist and typing narrows the options. Ticking a row adds a chip to the field, and picks beyond the limit fold into a plus count. The X clears everything.
demo_content: Label "Select Frameworks" with the options React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, Next.js and Nuxt
search_phrases: searchable checkbox list in a popover
choose multiple tags from a menu
pick multiple items in one field
use_when: A form needs several choices from a long list that users will want to search or clear.
avoid_when: maxCount quietly hides extra picks behind a plus count unless showall is set.
customise: options, defaultValue, placeholder, maxCount, showall and animation are props; chip and popover colours sit in the source.
weight_why: A button, a popover and a filtered list; nothing runs when closed.

a11y.note: Chip remove icons are bare SVGs with click handlers, so the keyboard cannot drop one pick; checkboxes have no roles.

issues: Nuxt is greyed out but nothing on screen explains why it cannot be chosen.
Chip remove icons are not buttons, so they are mouse-only.
polish_why: Full-featured and consistent; tiny remove icons and an unexplained disabled row hold it back.
title: Multi Selector
